suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went out on a Friday afternoon and nothing caught fire over the weekend.
I'm thankful for the uncle at the pasar malam who throws in an extra piece of ayam percik without being asked.
I'm grateful for waking up ten minutes before Fajr on my own, no alarm needed, like my body just knew.
I'm thankful for a code review comment that actually taught me something instead of just nitpicking semicolons.
I'm grateful for my dad calling just to ask if I've eaten, nothing else, every single time.
I'm thankful for the first sip of teh tarik after a meeting that ran way too long.
I'm grateful for a flaky test that finally admitted it was the test's fault, not mine.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of rent not going up this year when everyone else's did.
I'm grateful for a senior engineer who said "good question" instead of making me feel dumb for asking.
I'm thankful for the smell of rain on hot tarmac right before it actually starts pouring.
I'm grateful for an old group chat that still gets rowdy at 1am over nothing in particular.
I'm thankful for a terminal that finally stopped hanging after I cleared out node_modules for the third time.
I'm grateful for the short walk to the surau being covered enough that I don't need an umbrella.
I'm thankful for my mom's cooking showing up in a Tupperware I didn't even ask for.
I'm grateful for a Monday standup that ended early because, for once, nothing was actually on fire.
